mapper.select: SELECT MUR.mbid, (SELECT COUNT(mbid) FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST WHERE user_code = MUR.user_code and mb_request_date <= MUR.mb_request_date and mb_status = '07') AS use_cnt, IF(MUR.mb_status < '02', '신청', '완료') AS mb_status, DATE_FORMAT(MUR.mb_request_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS mb_request_date, MUR.mb_sales_amount, CU.USER_ID AS user_id, CU.USER_NM AS user_nm, CU.USER_NO, IFNULL(MSC.sub_complete, 'N') AS sub_complete, PPR.prizm_grade AS prizm_score, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST_SHOP MURS WHERE MURS.mbid = MUR.mbid) AS request_shop FROM CBCI_USER CU, MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST MUR LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_SUB_CHECK MSC ON MUR.mbid = MSC.mbid LEFT JOIN PRIZM_PCS_RESULT PPR ON MUR.mbid = PPR.mbid WHERE MUR.user_code = CU.USER_CODE AND CU.USER_NM LIKE #{user_nm} AND CU.FIRM_NM LIKE #{firm_nm} AND CU.USER_ID LIKE #{user_id} AND MUR.mb_status <= '07' AND MUR.mb_sales_amount >= #{minAmount} AND MUR.mb_sales_amount < #{maxAmount} AND MUR.mb_request_date >= #{fromDate} AND MUR.mb_request_date < #{toDate} ORDER BY ${order_by}, MUR.mbid DESC LIMIT ${limit}, 10

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN MUR.mb_status < '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS request, SUM(CASE WHEN MUR.mb_status >= '02' and MUR.mb_status <= '07' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finish, COUNT(*) as total FROM CBCI_USER CU, MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST MUR LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_SUB_CHECK MSC ON MUR.mbid = MSC.mbid LEFT JOIN PRIZM_PCS_RESULT PPR ON MUR.mbid = PPR.mbid WHERE MUR.user_code = CU.USER_CODE AND MUR.mb_status <= '07' AND MUR.mb_status <> '00' AND MUR.mb_sales_amount >= #{minAmount} AND MUR.mb_sales_amount < #{maxAmount} AND MUR.mb_request_date >= #{fromDate} AND MUR.mb_request_date < #{toDate}

SELECT MUR.mb_product_code, MUR.mbid, CU.USER_NM, CU.USER_NO, CU.USER_CODE, CU.USER_ID, CU.FIRM_NM, CU.FIRM_SETUP_DATE, MUR.mb_status, MUR.mb_request_date, MUR.reg_no_first, MUR.reg_no_second, MUR.mb_demand_acc_number, MUR.mb_main_acc_bank_code, MUR.mb_main_acc_holder, MUR.mb_main_acc_number FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST MUR, CBCI_USER CU WHERE MUR.user_code = CU.USER_CODE AND MUR.mbid = #{mbid}

SELECT COUNT(SSA.ORDER_NO) as MSQ, IFNULL(SUM(SSA.PAYMENT_AMOUNT),0) as PAYMENT_AMOUNT, IFNULL(SUM(SSA.ORDER_AMOUNT),0) as ORDER_AMOUNT, IFNULL(SUM(SSA.product_instant_discount_amount),0) as PROD_INST_DISC_AMOUNT, IFNULL(SUM(SSA.product_discount_coupon_amount),0) as PROD_DISC_COUPON_AMOUNT, IFNULL(SUM(SSA.product_purchase_discount_amount),0) as PROD_PURCHASE_DISC_AMOUNT, IFNULL(SUM(SSA.seller_discount_coupon_amount),0) as SELLER_DISC_COUPON_AMOUNT, IFNULL(SUM(SSA.seller_purchase_discount_amount),0) as SELLER_PURCHASE_DISC_AMOUNT, IFNULL(SUM(SSA.seller_discounts_amount),0) as SELLER_DISCS_AMOUNT, IFNULL(SUM(SSA.seller_purchase_discount_type),0) as SELLER_PURCHASE_DISC_TYPE, IFNULL(SUM(SSA.discount_amount),0) as DSIC_AMOUNT, IFNULL(SUM(SSA.shopping_mall_discount_amount),0) as SHOPPING_MALL_DISC_AMOUNT FROM SHOP_SALES_API SSA WHERE SSA.SHOP_TYPE = #{SHOP_TYPE} AND SSA.SHOP_ID = #{SHOP_ID} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(SSA.SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT),0) AS MSA, COUNT(SSA.SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT) AS COUNT_MSA FROM SHOP_SETTLEMENT_API SSA WHERE SSA.SHOP_TYPE =#{SHOP_TYPE} AND SSA.SHOP_ID = #{SHOP_ID} AND SSA.SETTLEMENT_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')

SELECT CASE WHEN SSA.SHOP_TYPE=2 THEN IFNULL(SUM(DATEDIFF(SSA.SETTLE_ESTIMATE_DATE,ADDDATE(SSA.DELIVERED_DATE,INTERVAL 1 DAY))),0) WHEN SSA.SHOP_TYPE=3 THEN IFNULL(SUM(DATEDIFF(SSA.SETTLE_ESTIMATE_DATE,ADDDATE(SSA.DELIVERED_DATE,INTERVAL 2 DAY))),0) WHEN SSA.SHOP_TYPE=4 THEN IFNULL(SUM(DATEDIFF(ADDDATE(SSA.DELIVERED_DATE,INTERVAL 9 DAY),SSA.DELIVERED_DATE)),0) WHEN SSA.SHOP_TYPE=11 THEN IFNULL(SUM(DATEDIFF(SSA.SETTLE_COMPLETE_DATE,ADDDATE(SSA.DELIVERED_DATE,INTERVAL 2 DAY))),0) WHEN SSA.SHOP_TYPE=14 THEN IFNULL(SUM(DATEDIFF(SSA.CONFIRM_DATE,ADDDATE(SSA.DELIVERED_DATE,INTERVAL 1 DAY))),0) END AS SUM_MSP , COUNT(SSA.ID) as COUNT_MSP FROM SHOP_SALES_API SSA WHERE SSA.SHOP_TYPE=#{SHOP_TYPE} AND SSA.SHOP_ID = #{SHOP_ID} AND CASE WHEN SSA.SHOP_TYPE=2 THEN SSA.SETTLE_ESTIMATE_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d') WHEN SSA.SHOP_TYPE=3 THEN SSA.SETTLE_ESTIMATE_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d') WHEN SSA.SHOP_TYPE=4 THEN SSA.DELIVERED_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d') WHEN SSA.SHOP_TYPE=11 THEN SSA.SETTLE_COMPLETE_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d') WHEN SSA.SHOP_TYPE=14 THEN SSA.CONFIRM_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d') END

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(DATEDIFF(SSA.DELIVERED_DATE, ADDDATE(SSA.PAID_DATE,INTERVAL 1 DAY))),0) AS SUM_MDP, COUNT(ID) AS COUNT_MDP FROM SHOP_SALES_API SSA WHERE SSA.SHOP_TYPE=#{SHOP_TYPE} AND SSA.SHOP_ID = #{SHOP_ID} AND SSA.DELIVERED_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')

SELECT MSC.mbid, MSC.biz_no, DATE_FORMAT(MSC.biz_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS biz_start_date, MSC.tax_type, MSC.biz_type, MSC.cb_score_current, MSC.cb_score_rank, MSC.cb_score_past, MSC.default_status, MSC.financial_disorder_status, MSC.public_information_status, MSC.overdue_status, MSC.cb_check, MSC.national_tax_full_payment, MSC.local_tax_full_payment, MSC.health_insurance_full_payment, MSC.health_insurance_paid_amount, MSC.sub_complete, MSC.cb_confirm_admin FROM MONEYBANK_SUB_CHECK MSC WHERE MSC.mbid = #{mbid}
SELECT CE.eval_no, CE.object_no, CE.eval_subject, CE.reviewer, CE.title, CE.detail, CE.input_date FROM CBCI_EVALUATE CE WHERE division = '02' AND object_no = #{mbid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MONEYBANK_SUB_CHECK ( mbid, cb_score_current, cb_score_rank, cb_score_past, default_status, financial_disorder_status, public_information_status, overdue_status, cb_check, cb_confirm_admin, input_date ) VALUES ( #{mbid}, #{cbScoreCurrent}, #{cbScoreRank}, #{cbScorePast}, #{defaultStatus}, #{financialDisorderStatus}, #{publicInformationStatus}, #{overdueStatus}, 'Y', #{userId}, now() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE cb_score_current = #{cbScoreCurrent}, cb_score_rank = #{cbScoreRank}, cb_score_past = #{cbScorePast}, default_status = #{defaultStatus}, financial_disorder_status = #{financialDisorderStatus}, public_information_status = #{publicInformationStatus}, overdue_status = #{overdueStatus}, cb_check = 'Y', cb_confirm_admin = #{userId}, upd_date = now()
INSERT INTO CBCI_EVALUATE( division, object_no, eval_subject, reviewer, title, detail, input_date ) VALUES ( '02', #{mbid}, '신청', #{reviewer}, #{title}, #{detail}, now() )
